column1: # Lucion Arena, Hellcaves, Hellcave Fortress (#829): legacy is a raised plateau whose cliff face drops below the floor into a black chasm, so the pick must stand low. pd2_fidelity types hellcaves_base walls as cliffs, so the pass borrows cliff-typed stock pieces for this line. act4/mesa/chain_walls.dt1 is the act 4 mesa kit (low rounded rock rims, cliff_straights/supports/corners): the floor ends at the rim and drops away, nothing stands above it. Compared in game against expansion/siege/rockcliff.dt1 (upright rock towers that hide the floor), act4/diab/walls.dt1 (brick ruin walls), expansion/baallair/walls.dt1 (brick walls), expansion/siege/cliff.dt1 (ice-capped rock) and expansion/icecave/interior.dt1 (frost). Stock has no piece for the lower variant 19 (orientation 4): the pass turns an orientation-3 piece half a circle about its tile for it
